OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true

              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.

              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence."

              title: Household ID

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence."
              type: string
              example: "FRA-0007"
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner joins an existing same-lastName household at the same address via sharesHousehold; every member shares one value."
              type: string
              example: "HH-1A2B3C4D"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'; two owners collide only when their whole keys match."
              type: string
              example: "+61400000001||"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year."
              type: string
              example: "SMI-0007-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level from 1 to 3: starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."

              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "PHONE"
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

## Summary

I implemented optional, city-aware `postcode` validation for owner creation, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions and keeping structural impact low by adding small, single-method units rather than growing existing classes.

**New behaviour (one cohesive step + its handler):**
- `ValidatePostcode.java` — a new single-method function inserted into the `POST /api/owners` pipeline. When a postcode is present it must be 4 digits and, for a city with a known region, fall in range (Sydney/NSW 2000–2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000–3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000–4099); unknown-region cities accept any 4-digit value; absent postcode is skipped. Invalid ones throw a checked exception.
- `InvalidPostcodeException.java` + `InvalidPostcodeExceptionHandler.java` + escalation YAML — respond `400` with `{"errors":["postcode"]}`, mirroring the existing email/telephone validators.

**Wiring & persistence (minimal edits):**
- `owners.POST.yml` — inserted the `validatePostcode` step between address normalization and the duplicate checks.
- `openapi.yml` — added the optional `postcode` property to `OwnerFields`, so the generated request/response DTOs carry it (keeping the request contract backward-compatible).
- `Owner.java` — added a `postcode` column field plus getter/setter; MapStruct maps it by name on the way in and out with no mapper changes.
- `db/hsqldb/schema.sql` — added the `postcode VARCHAR(4)` column; `db/hsqldb/data.sql` — added the matching `NULL` to each positional seed insert (required because those inserts omit a column list).

The region range check is enforced per the spec even though the tests only exercise the malformed and unknown-city cases.

Note: I only wired postcode into the create (POST) pipeline since that is what the spec and tests cover; the PUT/update pipeline's `ApplyOwner` was intentionally left untouched to keep the change scoped.
